content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I’d like to know how to produce a digital pulse whenever the analog value at the analog input changes. Thank you.
You can use the analog watchdog together with a flag. The flag is triggered by a change in value, generating a pulse in the cycle.
Thank you, this solution works as expected.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants exchanged advice on generating a digital pulse when the analog input value changes. The discussion highlighted that [product_name] enables this feature using its analog watchdog, which can trigger a pulse through a flag when a change is detected. Users confirmed the effectiveness of this method for their control application.
